description: August 30 birthday meaning: Virgo decan 1, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an August 30 birthday falls in Virgo, in the first decan, with Mercury as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Virgo is mutable and earth.

sections.heading: The August 30 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Expression takes careful form on August 30th. Six degrees into Virgo, under Mercury's first-decan influence, the creative number 3 tends to show up as crafted language, design or humour. Traditional readings describe a witty observer of everyday life, quick to notice absurdities. The usual advice is to share drafts before they feel perfect.

Astronomically, August 30 puts the Sun near 6° Virgo in most years, inside the first ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Mercury. Mercury rules Virgo and also governs its opening decan, from about August 23 to September 2. Doubled Mercury in an earth sign points towards analysis, method and a talent for noticing the detail everyone else walked past. People with these birthdays are often called helpful, articulate and quietly witty, with high standards for their own work. The flip side is a busy mind that can turn on itself, cataloguing flaws long after the job is done. Their best gift tends to be useful precision: making a system clearer, a text tighter or a routine kinder to the people who follow it.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for August 30
paragraphs: A birthday on the 30th reduces as 3 + 0 = 3. The 0 is often read as amplifying the 3, so this birthday number carries an extra dose of expression, imagination and social energy. Unlike the 12th or 21st, the compound contains only the 3 itself, which numerologists sometimes describe as creativity without dilution. Thirtieth-born people are frequently described as eloquent, entertaining and quick with ideas. As a secondary number, the 30 tends to shine in writing, speaking or performance. Focus is their usual challenge, since so many ideas compete for attention.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: an August 30 birthday gives Life Path 3 for 1990, 4 for 2000, 5 for 2010 and 6 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 22 and 33. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous August 30 birthdays
paragraphs: An August birthday falls in late northern summer, a season of early harvests and holidays, and in late winter for the southern hemisphere, when the first blossom starts to appear. Leo holds most of the month, with Virgo arriving around August 22 or 23. August is month 8 in numerology, associated with ambition, authority and material skill, a fitting partner for Leo's confidence. August 30 is the 242nd day of the year (243rd in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Libra, is usually complete within 24 days, by September 23.

By August 30 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with an August 30 birthday are Ernest Rutherford (1871), Alexander Lukashenka (1954) and Warren Buffett (1930).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is August 30?
faq.answer: August 30 is Virgo in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Virgo, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on August 30?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On August 30 the Life Path is 9 in 1960, 1 in 1970, 2 in 1980, 3 in 1990, 4 in 2000, 5 in 2010 and 6 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 30th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on August 30?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by August 30, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on August 30?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on August 30 include Ernest Rutherford (1871), Alexander Lukashenka (1954) and Warren Buffett (1930). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
